title: Spike: countdown banner and hreflang prototype in preview
description: The edge redirect is removed from the design (Ryan's decision 6). Prototype the client-side countdown banner and hreflang output on tools/preview_production.py: matching navigator.languages to page alternates (zh-CN/zh-SG to zh-Hans), the remembered reading language, location.replace and Back, pause on scroll, aria-live, reduced motion, and the 'never toward the primary' rule. Check with a search engine's URL inspection that a translated page is rendered without redirecting. Not started: the coordinator asked to hold anything needing a deployed preview stack. Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450), revised 2026-11-12 with Ryan's decisions.
